name: Query identity and scope from the same frozen physical observations
role: bounded opened-development mechanism comparison, not a new default
source_observations: all 1107 legal sampled frames and 39360 original regions

candidates.name: scope_hypotheses
candidates.map: one physical scope hypothesis per original supported region
candidates.identity: confidence-weighted mean native cosine across one matching region per view

candidates.name: view_exclusive_tracks
candidates.map: mutual physical correspondence, greedy strongest-first merging, at most one region per view per track
candidates.identity: mean native cosine across track observations
candidates.points: positive geometric anchor; maximum Beta(1,1) smoothed support among anchor-compatible tracks
candidates.scope: equal-view strict majority within the selected track

evaluation.cohort: 9 scenes, 67 targets, all 268 independent positive queries
evaluation.consumed_output: four separate actual selected-set IoU values
evaluation.paired_secondary: same-target all-four success and set agreement
evaluation.public_jobs: all original jobs retained in recipes; unchanged public readers are not rerun or credited with a new improvement
evaluation.diagnostic: GT-selected best candidate only after complete automatic predictions; separate from method scores

decision: Do not promote a cross-view mechanism that improves consistency or ranking while worsening actual target extraction. No parameter sweep or benchmark-target routing.
